title: 19岁摔跤手做了个AI摔跤教练App，10万下载、近20万美元收入
originalTitle: AI Apps Are Making $10K/Month. Here's Exactly How.
summary: George Lampropoulos 19岁时用AI编程做出摔跤训练App WrestleAI，面向和他一样的摔跤选手给出训练建议。App 下载超过10万次，累计收入接近20万美元；中文二手传播里，这个故事被写成“零编程基础、一个月做出、月入1.7万美元”。
quote: 我当时吓坏了，我们的App完全靠这个功能……那可能是我这辈子最挫败的时刻之一。
quoteOriginal: I freaked out cuz our app entirely relied on this. Not only is it broken, not only is everyone going to subscribe and refund and I felt just so defeated in in that moment, probably one of the most defeated I've ever felt.
